text: It seems the APPEARIFIER cannot appearify something if it will create a TIME PARADOX.
A GELATINOUS GHOST PUMPKIN appearifies and quickly dissolves into a pile of UNAPPETIZING SLUDGE.
alt: The screen reads: PARADOXIFY. A green, gelatinous ghost pumpkin appears and splats onto the platform.
command: WV: Appearify the grate over the entrance to the facility.
